name: Venomtail Poison Sac
summary: In Durotar, a scorpion’s venom can bring a hunter near death, while its poison sac holds what alchemists need to make a cure.

sections.title: A Deadly Toxin and Its Remedy
sections.body: Scorpids roam Durotar’s red rocks, including Venomtail Scorpids, Corrupted Scorpids, and the Death Flayer. Their tail sacs hold a fast-acting venom that can overwhelm even seasoned warriors if left untreated. The same sacs contain the primary compounds alchemists need to make an antidote. When a scorpion stung the hunter Rhinag outside Orgrimmar, local alchemists needed four fresh poison sacs to make a remedy and neutralize the venom in his veins.

faq.q: What creatures carry these poison sacs?
aliases: where to get venomtail poison sac
faq.answer: Scorpids in Durotar carry the poison sacs, chiefly Venomtail Scorpids near Orgrimmar, along with Corrupted Scorpids and the rare Death Flayer.

faq.q: What is the poison sac used for?
aliases: why do i need venomtail poison sac
faq.answer: Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar uses the sacs to distill a specialized antidote, urgently needed to treat Rhinag after he was stung and poisoned while hunting without proper preparation.

faq.q: Who can brew the antidote from these sacs?
aliases: where to turn in venomtail sacs
faq.answer: Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar knows how to refine the raw venom from four intact sacs into a curative draft before the poison proves fatal.

angles.text: As a young Horde adventurer in Durotar, you learn that local toxins can kill those who rush into the red wastes unprepared.
As a hunter, you can take Rhinag’s misfortune as a warning: pursuing dangerous beasts without knowing their venom or carrying a remedy can cost you your life.
